# Occam SEO

> Occam SEO is an SEO consultancy based in Apex, North Carolina, offering technical SEO, local SEO, content strategy, link building, SEO audits, and website design and development for small and mid-sized businesses in the Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill area (the Triangle).

Occam SEO LLC is founded and run by John W. Youngblood. The agency's approach is built on Occam's Razor: the simplest strategy that works wins, so it focuses on the few fixes and pages that actually move rankings. It serves Apex, Cary, Raleigh, Durham, and the wider Triangle. Contact: john@occam-seo.com.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.occam-seo.com/services.html): All Occam SEO services in one place.
- [Technical SEO](https://www.occam-seo.com/technical-seo.html): Crawlability, Core Web Vitals, structured data, indexation, sitemaps, and duplicate-URL fixes.
- [Local SEO](https://www.occam-seo.com/local-seo.html): Map pack and local organic rankings, Google Business Profile optimization, citations, and NAP consistency for Triangle-area businesses.
- [SEO Audits](https://www.occam-seo.com/seo-audits.html): A comprehensive audit with a prioritized, plain-language action plan.
- [Content Strategy](https://www.occam-seo.com/content-strategy.html): Keyword research and page architecture focused on fewer, better pages.
- [Link Building](https://www.occam-seo.com/link-building.html): Earned links from relevant sources; no PBNs or spam.
- [Website Design](https://www.occam-seo.com/website-design.html): Fast, SEO-ready websites built from the ground up.

## Pricing

- [Rate Card](https://www.occam-seo.com/pricing.html): Current prices for all services. As of November 2026:
  - SEO Audit: $300 flat fee
  - Website Cleanup (fixes to an existing site): $80/hour, estimated after an audit
  - Website Design: $1,000 plus $60/hour for additional work; includes technical SEO, local SEO, content strategy, and Google Business Profile setup
  - The Razor Package (ongoing SEO and website updates): $80/hour, hours set to the client's monthly budget, 3-month minimum
  - Corporate Rate (for companies that refer clients): $65/hour
  - Consulting (ongoing SEO and marketing advice): $300/month
